clean_repro.observed: Insert succeeded (HTTP 200), query returned text_field=12345 as integer - type coercion occurred

verified_assumptions: REST v2 API should validate data types before insert
VarChar fields should reject non-string values
JSON unmarshal should fail for type mismatch

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_type_entities_insert_001 - 'data field types match collection schema'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: handleInsert() → WrappedInsertRequest.AsInsertRequest() → convertFieldDataArray() → FieldData.AsSchemapb() → json.Unmarshal(raw, &data) for VarChar
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:VarChar字段使用 json.Unmarshal(raw, &data) 直接反序列化到[]string，但Go的json.Unmarshal对类型不匹配会执行自动类型转换而非报错。例如JSON数字12345会被自动转换为字符串"12345"。这是Go json包的标准行为，但在数据库语义下这是bug - 应该拒绝类型不匹配而非隐式转换。

falsification.probe: Query with filter to verify stored data type
falsification.observed: Query returned text_field as integer 12345, confirming coercion occurred in storage layer

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 insert端点在VarChar字段上执行了隐式类型转换：当传入JSON数字(如12345)到字符串字段时，Go的json.Unmarshal自动将其转为字符串'12345'并成功插入。这违反了契约(milvus_type_entities_insert_001)明确要求的'data field types match collection schema'，且破坏了数据库类型安全性。源码wrap_request.go:141-155显示VarChar处理直接使用json.Unmarshal(raw, &data)到[]string，依赖json库的自动类型转换而非严格验证。属于开发者认知中的高频盲点区域(REST v2数据类型序列化，历史issue 52232/52230/52229)。复现步骤确认：create collection → insert with integer to VarChar → 200 success → query returns coerced value。
